title: feat: gen (lavfi animated backgrounds), vdenoise --engine bm3d, eq --graphic (RSI round 192)
body:
## Summary

RSI round 192 — generative backgrounds (first no-input verb) + the strongest spatial denoiser + classic graphic EQ, each verified empirically on ffmpeg 4.4.

- `gen` — animated backgrounds from lavfi sources, **no input file** (`-o` only): `--pattern mandelbrot` (fractal zoom, `--zoom` end-scale depth), `gradients` (drifting palette — `--colors` up to 8, `--seed`, `--speed`), `life` (cellular automaton, `--rule` 0-255). `--size`/`--fps`/`--dur`. Music-visualizer backdrops, VJ loops, text-card canvases.
- `vdenoise --engine bm3d` — patch-stack Wiener denoising, the strongest spatial denoiser ffmpeg ships. `sigma=strength*8` mapping (measured: flat-region luma stdev 16.1 → 2.7 on noise=25 at strength 6; sigma<8 was a no-op). bm3d has no `enable` timeline support → `--at` returns a clear `input` error pointing at the windowed engines.
- `eq --graphic "dB,dB,..."` — classic 18-slider graphic EQ (`superequalizer`, 65Hz..20kHz); dB values convert to gain multipliers `10^(dB/20)`. Verified: band 9 (≈1kHz) at -18dB cuts a 1kHz tone by 18.2dB.

Also removed a dead `LevelerEngine::Dynaudnorm` match arm (variant reverted — dynaudnorm is a verified passthrough on brew ffmpeg 4.4.8).

## Test plan

- [x] `gen` renders all three patterns at correct dims/duration (asserted in test)
- [x] bm3d: flat-region luma stdev halved vs input fixture; `--at` rejected (`error.kind=input`)
- [x] `eq --graphic` 9th band -18dB → 1kHz tone measured >12dB lower (volumedetect)
- [x] `cargo test` 472 cli + 4 contract + 17 unit green; `clippy -D warnings` + `fmt` clean on ffmpeg 4.4 toolchain
